_readme: English translations for the DB catalog, applied by scripts/import-translations.ts.
German is the source language and stays in the bare columns; this fills the *En siblings.
`strings` is a flat German -> English map applied to every category string, including
recursively through the `detail` JSON. Film and variant names map to themselves so they
are not reported as untranslated. Anything absent stays German on /en.
`products` is keyed by product code and covers the two public prose fields.

strings.Die metallisierte Reflexionsfolie für st: The metallised reflective film for heavily sun-exposed glazing. Reflective layers cut heat gain and glare — above all where heat is the main problem.
strings.Reflektierende Schichten reduzieren Wärm: Reflective layers reduce heat gain and glare. Particularly suited to offices, glass façades and commercial buildings.
strings.Feine, dicht aufgetragene Partikel block: Fine, densely applied particles block solar energy instead of reflecting it — giving a brighter, more neutral result with no mirror effect.
strings.Eine hauchdünne, im Vakuum aufgesputtert: A wafer-thin metal-oxide layer, vacuum-sputtered onto the film, acts as a spectrally selective filter: it blocks infrared and UV radiation selectively rather than mirroring the whole of the sunlight — so the glass keeps a neutral look and stays brighter than a classic reflective film of the same heat-rejection class.
strings.Reduzieren die Infrarotstrahlung über ei: Reduce infrared radiation across a broad range of wavelengths while still letting plenty of visible light through. Particularly suited to residential and retail properties that want an understated look to the glass.

Reduce infrared radiation across a broad range of wavelengths while still letting plenty of visible light through. More comfort for owners and tenants of flats and houses: less heat gain, less glare, and protection for furniture, flooring, curtains and other furnishings against fading.
strings.Wo die Serie R mit einer reflektierenden: Where the R Series works with a reflective aluminium layer, this series filters solar energy out spectrally selectively. At the same VLT that costs a little TSER — in return the glass stays less conspicuous from outside and does not read as a mirror during the day.
strings.Wohn- und Einzelhandelsobjekte mit dezen: Residential and retail properties with an understated look to the glass
strings.Sonnenschutzfolie · Spektralselektiv · L: Solar control film · Spectrally selective · LLumar
strings.Unterschied zur Serie R: How it differs from the R Series
strings.Wo der Spiegeleffekt stört: Where the mirror effect is a problem
strings.Halten Glassplitter zusammen und erschwe: Hold glass fragments together and make rapid entry harder. Particularly suited to banks, schools, kindergartens, public buildings and terrace glazing.
strings.Sicherheitsfolie · Geprüft nach DIN EN 3: Safety film · Tested to DIN EN 356 & EN 12600
Safety film · Tested to DIN EN 356
strings.Klar wie Glas, aber mit Rückhaltewirkung: Clear as glass, but with retention: on impact the film spreads the force across the whole pane. The glass breaks — the fragments stay on the film and in the frame. Two independent tests document the effect.

Clear as glass, but with retention: on impact the film spreads the force across the whole pane. The glass breaks — the fragments stay on the film and in the frame. The EN 356 ball-drop test documents the effect.
strings.Drei Probekörper 1100 × 900 mm, 6 mm Flo: Three specimens of 1100 × 900 mm, 6 mm float glass with ARM Safety clear 12 mil (300 µ). Three impacts each from a drop height of 1500 mm. Result: the glass broke, penetration in no case — class P1A.
strings.Fünf Probekörper 876 × 1938 mm, 4 mm Flo: Five specimens of 876 × 1938 mm, 4 mm float glass with ARM Safety — the fragments are held together by the film. Class 2 (B) 2.
strings.Einbruchhemmung ist nicht Verletzungssch: Burglary resistance is not injury protection
strings.12 mil verzögert das Eindringen — das is: 12 mil delays entry — that is the job of EN 356. Holding the fragments together is the job of EN 12600. Which thickness is right is decided by the use, not the price.
strings.12 mil verzögert das Eindringen und hält: 12 mil delays entry and holds the fragments together — tested to EN 356. Which thickness is right is decided by the use, not the price.
strings.Die klaren Safety-Folien weisen nur 2 bi: The clear Safety films reject only 2 to 13 % of solar energy. If you need heat rejection and shatter protection at once, combine the Safety Series with a solar control film or choose a tinted safety variant.

The clear Safety films reject only 2 to 20 % of solar energy. If you need heat rejection and shatter protection at once, combine the Safety Series with a solar control film or choose a tinted safety variant.
strings.Durchwurfhemmung nach EN 356: Resistance to manual attack to EN 356
strings.Lichtdurchlass — höchster Wert im Sortim: Light transmission — the highest figure in the range
strings.Prüfberichte 2022-08-5319-04 (EN 356, AR: Test reports 2022-08-5319-04 (EN 356, ARM Safety clear 12 mil on 4 mm float). The classification applies to the glass build-up as tested.
strings.Prüfbericht 2022-08-5319-04 (EN 356, ARM: Test report 2022-08-5319-04 (EN 356, ARM Safety clear 12 mil on 6 mm float). The classification applies to the glass build-up as tested.
strings.Opferschicht gegen Kratzer und Graffiti: Sacrificial layer against scratches and graffiti
strings.UV-Schutzfolie · Nahezu unsichtbar: UV protection film · All but invisible
strings.Kein Metall, keine Tönung — ein UV-Absor: No metal, no tint — a UV absorber in the polyester filters out > 99 % of radiation below 380 nm. Material thickness 2 mil.
strings.Reduzieren UV-Strahlung bei weitgehend n: Reduce UV radiation while leaving the glass looking largely natural. Particularly suited to museums, shop windows and galleries.

Reduce UV radiation while leaving the glass looking largely natural. At 89 % light transmission the film is practically impossible to spot once fitted — the display stays as bright and colour-true as it would be without it.
strings.Verringerung des durch UV-Strahlung veru: Reduces UV-induced fading of high-value goods and materials through over 99 % UV rejection — in textile and clothing shops, furniture stores and museums, for example.
strings.UV ist nicht die einzige Ursache: UV is not the only cause
strings.Ausbleichen entsteht zu einem Teil auch: Fading is caused in part by visible light and heat as well. Over 99 % UV rejection slows the process markedly but does not stop it entirely — an expectation worth raising openly during the consultation.
strings.Mit 15 % TSER senkt diese Folie die Raum: At 15 % TSER this film barely lowers the room temperature noticeably, and at 2 % glare reduction it cuts glare practically not at all. If you need both, reach for the R Series or combine the two films on different sides of the façade.
strings.Eine blickdichte Fensterfolie als Sichts: An opaque window film providing privacy for suitable glazing, plus UV protection for high-value goods in watch and jewellery shops.
strings.Werte für UV Protection Clear 2 mil an E: Figures for UV Protection Clear 2 mil on single glazing, source: the Armolan sample book. TSER 15 %, shading coefficient 0.98. The actual effect depends on the type of glass, the film technology, the level of sunlight and the orientation of the window.
strings.Mehr Privatsphäre und weniger störende R: More privacy and fewer distracting reflections on screens in offices and workspaces.
strings.Milchglas ohne Glastausch: Frosted glass without replacing the pane
strings.66 % Lichtdurchlass bei vollständig gest: 66 % light transmission with the image fully diffused: the room stays bright and silhouettes disappear. The usual choice for meeting rooms and office partitions.
strings.75 % Lichtdurchlass — der höchste Wert d: 75 % light transmission — the highest in the series — with a frosted surface. The choice where the room has to stay bright and still give nothing away. The only variant in the series without the over-99 % UV rejection.
strings.15 % VLT bei 89 % Lichtreflexion — für S: 15 % VLT at 89 % light reflection — for washrooms, storage areas and any surface meant to read as a white plane. Also suitable as a carrier for plotted company lettering.
strings.Mattierte Oberfläche mit metallisierter: Frosted surface with a metallised layer: 13 % VLT, 75 % TSER, 86 % glare reduction. Worth it where the pane is heavily sun-exposed at the same time.
strings.Sichtschutz und Hitzeschutz zugleich: Privacy and heat rejection at once
strings.Anders als eine Spiegelfolie arbeitet ei: Unlike a mirror film, a frosted film works independently of the light levels — at night as well. In return the view out is lost; worth settling in advance for windows facing living space.
strings.Die Spiegelwirkung schützt tagsüber vor: The mirror effect keeps people from seeing in during the day, while the view out is retained from inside. At night the effect reverses: with the lights on inside, everything is visible again from outside.
strings.Ohne eine solche Folie beträgt die Energ: Without a film of this kind, energy transmission is 83 %, reflection 8 % and absorption 9 %. Fit a solar control film — LLumar R20 SR CDF, for example — and only 11 % of the solar energy is transmitted, while 57 % is reflected and 32 % absorbed.
strings.Werte für R Silver 20 (Armolan) an Einfa: Figures for R Silver 20 (Armolan) on single glazing. For other variants — LLumar included — see the table. Please check against the current manufacturer data sheet. The actual effect depends on the type of glass, the film technology, the level of sunlight and the orientation of the window.
strings.Werte für Helios Spectrally Selective (L: Figures for Helios Spectrally Selective (LLumar) on single glazing. For other variants see the table. Please check against the current manufacturer data sheet. The actual effect depends on the type of glass, the film technology, the level of sunlight and the orientation of the window.
strings.Werte an Einfachverglasung, Quelle: Armo: Figures on single glazing, source: the Armolan sample book. Silver Matt also works as solar control (75 % TSER); White Matt effectively does not (19 % TSER).
strings.Vom Hersteller als DEVELOPMENTAL TECHNIC: Marked by the manufacturer as DEVELOPMENTAL TECHNICAL DATA — provisional figures. Emissivity, Ug value and colour rendering are not published.
strings.3 Folien für dieselbe Aufgabe in drei Ab: Three films for the same job in three grades: let light in, keep eyes out. No need to replace the glazing — the film is bonded to the existing glass and can be removed without residue if required.
strings.Bürofassaden, Architekturglas, Wohnräume: Office façades, architectural glass, living spaces with a view out — anywhere heat rejection is wanted but a mirrored façade is not. Six of the 29 variants (the Helios line) are also available as an exterior film.
strings.Die metallisierte Reflexionsfolie für st: The metallised reflective film for heavily sun-exposed glazing. Where heat is the main problem — south façades, shop windows, roof glazing — the R Series is the most economical answer. Eighteen variants from Armolan (10) and LLumar (8) cover everything from the almost opaque film for industrial halls to the light office filter.
strings.Eine hauchdünne Aluminium-Legierung refl: A wafer-thin aluminium alloy reflects the infrared part of the sunlight before it reaches the glass. Scratch-resistant hardcoat surface, material thickness 2 mil.
strings.Mit 89 % Lichtdurchlass ist diese Folie: At 89 % light transmission this film is practically impossible to spot once fitted — the display stays as bright and colour-true as it would be without it. It has exactly one job: to take away the radiation that makes colours fade.
strings.Museen, Galerien, Juweliere, Modegeschäf: Museums, galleries, jewellers, fashion shops, pharmacies, showrooms — anywhere goods are on display and still have to remain clearly visible.
strings.Statt Sonnenwärme wie ein Spiegel zurück: Rather than throwing solar heat back like a mirror, this coating selectively filters out the wavelengths that carry heat and lets visible light through comparatively unhindered. The result: a neutral, barely reflective look with a noticeable cooling effect. Twenty-nine variants cover the range from discreetly tinted to all but invisible.
strings.Süd- und Westfassaden, Schaufenster, Win: South and west façades, shop windows, conservatories, roof glazing, production and storage halls. Eight of the 18 variants are also available as an exterior film — for buildings with no access from inside.
strings.Von dezent bis nahezu unsichtbar: From discreet to all but invisible
strings.Werte für Helios Spectrally Selective (L: Figures for Helios Spectrally Selective (LLumar) on single glazing. For other variants see the table. Please check against the current manufacturer data sheet.
strings.Werte für R Silver 20 (Armolan) an Einfa: Figures for R Silver 20 (Armolan) on single glazing. For other variants — LLumar included — see the table. Please check against the current manufacturer data sheet.
strings.Werte für UV Protection Clear 2 mil an E: Figures for UV Protection Clear 2 mil on single glazing, source: the Armolan sample book. TSER 15 %, shading coefficient 0.98.
strings.Zwischen 10 % und 78 % Lichtdurchlass li: Between 10 % and 78 % light transmission lie every grade from a clearly visible tint to a film you barely notice once it is fitted. The lighter the variant, the lower the heat rejection — the same trade-off as in the R Series applies here too.
